behavior: A deliberate understory foliage-gleaner that moves with short hops and brief flights, often pausing to tilt its head before picking or hovering for insects. It also eats fruit outside the breeding season, remains territorial, and frequently sings from dense cover.
field_marks: Bright white adult iris framed by bold yellow spectacles
Gray head contrasting with olive-green upperparts
Thick, dark, straight bill with a slightly hooked tip
Whitish throat and belly with yellow-washed flanks
Dark wings crossed by two distinct white wing bars
Dark legs and a moderately long, olive-edged tail
habitat: Dense scrub and low tangled vegetation, including bramble thickets, woodland edges, second-growth forest, overgrown fields, and streamside or wetland thickets.
